stem:
The initial value of a home is $200,000. The value of the home will increase at a rate of 6% each year.

Which graph best models this situation?

options.label: F
options.text: Graph with starting value at 200,000 and a moderate upward curve reaching near 900,000 by 27 years

options.label: H
options.text: Graph with starting value at 200,000 and a very steep upward curve reaching near 900,000 by 8 years

options.label: G
options.text: Graph with starting value at 100,000 and a very steep upward curve reaching near 900,000 by 8 years

options.label: J
options.text: Graph with starting value at 100,000 and a gradual upward curve reaching near 600,000 by 27 years

visual_elements: 4 line graphs labeled F, H, G, J with axes labeled 'Value (dollars)' vs 'Time (years)'. Graphs F and H both start at 200,000 on y-axis and Graphs G and J start at 100,000. Graph F shows gradual exponential growth, Graph H and G show very steep curve, Graph J shows slow growth.
notes: Four graphs depict possible exponential growths. Only graphs F and H start at the given initial value $200,000; G and J start incorrectly at 100,000. The value increases by 6% per year, which is moderate growth, best modeled by graph F.
